asChild.description: Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

disabled.description: Whether the menubar (and all its menu triggers) is disabled.

id.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the menubar. Useful for composition.

loopFocus.description: Whether to loop the keyboard navigation across the triggers.

render.description:
Render the part as a custom element, combining their props and behavior.

A template can't take an element as a prop value, so this is a snippet rather than react's
`render` prop. It receives the props to bind and the part's state.
